meta.title: Activity of Polish MEPs
meta.votes_note: Roll-call votes of the European Parliament from July 2004: terms 6 to 8 (to April 2019) from VoteWatch Europe (Hix, Frantescu and Hagemann 2022), terms 9 and 10 (from July 2019) from HowTheyVote.eu (Open Database License, attribution required). Both compile the plenary minutes' roll-call results and are secondary sources; over July 2019 to June 2022, where they overlap, they agree on the Polish MEPs' attendance within one percentage point. Attendance is the share of the roll-call votes held during the mandate on which the MEP cast a vote (for, against or abstain). Loyalty is the share of votes cast that matched the plurality position of the MEP's EP group, or of the Polish MEPs of the same national party; votes with no plurality are left out.
meta.body_note: Committees, delegations and working groups, from the European Parliament's open data (official). Consecutive terms of one body in the same role are joined into one row. Roles are the EP's own: member, substitute, chair, vice-chair, observer.
